subject_rule: Limited to STEM: the degree programme must be formally classified as a STEM discipline, including but not limited to the fields in the AAUW list; AAUW uses the DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List to decide others. Eligibility is by the classification of the degree programme, not the applicant's research topic.

notes: The AAUW list has 118 entries in 9 categories (116 distinct names; Bioinformatics appears under both Life & Biological Sciences and Computer, Data & Information Sciences, and Computer Engineering under both Computer, Data & Information Sciences and Specialized & Interdisciplinary Engineering). Each distinct name is recorded once per level with its categories in the detail.

Recorded: master's 116 fields; doctorate 116 fields plus 9 professional doctorates from the Medicine list (MD, DO, DDS, DMD, OD, DC, DPM, PharmD, DVM). The page says the lists are 'including but not limited to' the fields shown, so the list is official but not closed; the DHS STEM list decides other programmes.
The page does not say whether the Medicine list applies to the master's award; it is recorded under the doctorate only because the entries are doctoral degrees.

Some fields are qualified in the source: Geography, Architecture, Urban Planning, Psychology/Psychiatry, Public Health and Econometrics count only in quantitative, scientific, technical or engineering tracks. The qualifier is kept in the name.
The first pass stored the nine category headings with example fields; this pass replaces them with the individual fields named by AAUW.
not_stated: Whether the Medicine list (professional doctorates) is open to the master's award
A closed list of STEM programmes: the page says 'including but not limited to' and points to the DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List for others
fetch_problems: The AAUW PDF returned an access-denied answer to a plain download request; it was read through the web-fetch tool instead, and its text matches the web page list entry for entry. The DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List was not opened (it is a government list outside the AAUW pages).
